text:
nina_cs: Team, new client 'Harbor' hitting 429s during Node SDK onboarding ramp (~220 parallel). Seeing auth failures + insufficient_quota. Can infra advise quick mitigations?

devin_eng: Can you paste the exact init + a couple log lines? Common pattern is preflight per tab causing a stampede.

client-sre: Logs: 
```
[2026-05-02T08:22:10Z] uid=hb-01 auth=ok token_age=2s status=200
[2026-05-02T08:22:10Z] uid=hb-02 auth=failed error=insufficient_quota
[2026-05-02T08:22:10Z] uid=hb-03 status=429 message="rate limit exceeded"
```
Init snippet: 
```
const rw = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await rw.preflight(); // called on every session/tab open
```

devin_eng: Yep, preflight-per-session. Immediate fixes: (1) cache preflight in process for 30-60s, (2) add randomized splay before preflight during warmup, (3) use one ephemeral token per session rather than per-request, (4) enable http2 keepalive to reduce connection churn.

nina_cs: Can you give a tiny code snippet we can drop into their repo? Keep it minimal.

devin_eng: Sure paste this: 
```
// node: process-level cached preflight + jitter
let pf={ts:0,res:null};
async function cachedPreflight(){
  if(Date.now()-pf.ts<40000) return pf.res; // 40s
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, Math.floor(Math.random()*250)+75));
  pf = {ts:Date.now(), res: await rw.preflight()};
  return pf.res;
}
```

ratebot: Alert: key=rw_live_**** hit onboarding-throttle at 2026-05-02T08:22:10Z. Window=120s peak_rps=61 avg_rps=15. Recommend reduce concurrent preflight to <=20 or request temp warmup.

client-sre: Implemented 40s cache + 75-325ms splay + reduced parallelism to 18. Quick canary shows 429s drop from ~35% of sessions to ~2-3%.

devin_eng: Good. Follow-ups: if they need >20 concurrent warmup for a short window, CS can file a ticket for a temporary quota bump (10 minutes). If expecting sustained >50 rps, discuss Dedicated warmup/reserved capacity. Also recommend they log token_age and source ip for each preflight so we can correlate.

nina_cs: I'll open the support ticket template and ask for canary timestamps. client-sre, please paste the ticket id when ready and we'll coordinate a temporary bump if needed.

client-sre: Filing ticket now, id: TICK-20260502-77. Will add canary times and post back. Thanks all!
